observations: Photo 0 shows a close-up of a car engine with a timing belt, pulleys, and hoses.
Photo 1 shows the full engine with a black plastic cover and a visible 'JAPAN' sticker on the top.
Photo 2 shows the engine from a side angle with a shiny aluminum cylinder head.
The engine appears used with some dirt and oil residue visible in all photos.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'GOD OF ABRAHAM INVESTMENT' are present on all images.

claims.claim: Dealer in all kinds of Japanese parts engine and accessories
claims.evidence: No photo shows this clearly enough to read.

risks.risk: The engine may not be a genuine Japanese part or may be a used import.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's identification plate (usually on the engine block or a stamped metal plate).

risks.risk: Internal mechanical damage such as seized pistons, broken valves, or blown head gaskets.
risks.proof: A video of the engine running or a compression test result.

risks.risk: Missing or damaged accessories like the alternator, ECU, or fuel pump.
risks.proof: A photo of all included accessories and a functional test of each.
risks.if_unproven: as a bare engine with no accessories

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the engine's identification plate (usually stamped on the block).
Photo of the engine with all accessories included.
Video of the engine starting and running.
Photo of the engine with a handwritten note showing the current date.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
